mapper.select: select id, name, period_type as periodType, year_val as year, month_val as month, deleted from fin_budget where user_id = #{userId} and month_key = #{monthKey} and coalesce(deleted,0)=0 limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into fin_budget (id, user_id, month_key, name, period_type, year_val, month_val, deleted, created_at, updated_at) values (#{budget.id}, #{userId}, #{monthKey}, #{budget.name}, #{budget.periodType}, #{budget.year}, #{budget.month}, coalesce(#{budget.deleted},0), now(3), now(3))
mapper.select: select id, budget_id as budgetId, category_code as categoryCode, bucket_key as bucketKey, limit_amount as limitAmount, rollover from fin_budget_line where budget_id = #{budgetId}
mapper.insert: insert into fin_budget_line (id, budget_id, user_id, category_code, bucket_key, limit_amount, rollover, created_at, updated_at) values (#{line.id}, #{line.budgetId}, #{userId}, #{line.categoryCode}, #{line.bucketKey}, #{line.limitAmount}, #{line.rollover}, now(3), now(3))
mapper.update: update fin_budget_line set category_code = #{line.categoryCode}, bucket_key = #{line.bucketKey}, limit_amount = #{line.limitAmount}, rollover = #{line.rollover}, updated_at = now(3) where id = #{line.id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from fin_budget_line where user_id = #{userId}

select id, name, amount, due_day as dueDay, recurrence, account_id as accountId, category_code as categoryCode, enabled, deleted from fin_bill where user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(deleted,0)=0 order by due_day
mapper.insert: insert into fin_bill (id, user_id, name, amount, due_day, recurrence, account_id, category_code, enabled, deleted, created_at, updated_at) values (#{bill.id}, #{userId}, #{bill.name}, #{bill.amount}, #{bill.dueDay}, #{bill.recurrence}, #{bill.accountId}, #{bill.categoryCode}, coalesce(#{bill.enabled},1), coalesce(#{bill.deleted},0), now(3), now(3))
mapper.update: update fin_bill set name = #{bill.name}, amount = #{bill.amount}, due_day = #{bill.dueDay}, recurrence = #{bill.recurrence}, account_id = #{bill.accountId}, category_code = #{bill.categoryCode}, enabled = #{bill.enabled}, deleted = #{bill.deleted}, updated_at = now(3) where id = #{bill.id}
update fin_bill set deleted = 1, enabled = 0, updated_at = now(3) where id = #{billId} and user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(deleted, 0) = 0
mapper.select: select count(*) from fin_bill where user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(deleted,0)=0

select id, name, goal_type as goalType, target_amount as targetAmount, current_amount as currentAmount, target_date as targetDate, monthly_contribution as monthlyContribution, linked_account_id as linkedAccountId, deleted from fin_financial_goal where user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(deleted,0)=0
mapper.insert: insert into fin_financial_goal (id, user_id, name, goal_type, target_amount, current_amount, target_date, monthly_contribution, linked_account_id, deleted, created_at, updated_at) values (#{goal.id}, #{userId}, #{goal.name}, #{goal.goalType}, #{goal.targetAmount}, #{goal.currentAmount}, #{goal.targetDate}, #{goal.monthlyContribution}, #{goal.linkedAccountId}, coalesce(#{goal.deleted},0), now(3), now(3))
mapper.update: update fin_financial_goal set name = #{goal.name}, goal_type = #{goal.goalType}, target_amount = #{goal.targetAmount}, current_amount = #{goal.currentAmount}, target_date = #{goal.targetDate}, monthly_contribution = #{goal.monthlyContribution}, linked_account_id = #{goal.linkedAccountId}, deleted = #{goal.deleted}, updated_at = now(3) where id = #{goal.id}
mapper.select: select count(*) from fin_financial_goal where user_id = #{userId} and coalesce(deleted,0)=0
mapper.insert: insert into fin_metric_monthly (user_id, month_key, metric_code, metric_value, computed_at) values (#{userId}, #{yearMonth}, #{metricCode}, #{value}, now(3)) on duplicate key update metric_value = #{value}, computed_at = now(3)
mapper.select: select metric_value from fin_metric_monthly where user_id = #{userId} and month_key = #{yearMonth} and metric_code = #{metricCode}
